name: change_backlog_folder
description:
Change the folder for backlog tasks

WARNING: this modifies the user's task organisation — it moves the named backlog tasks into a different folder, which changes where they appear for anyone sharing that backlog. The schema takes only `taskIds`: the destination folder is not a parameter and is not visible from the call, so you cannot tell the user where the tasks will end up. Confirm the exact tasks with the user, say that the destination is decided by Sunsama rather than by this call, and never infer the task list from earlier API output.

taskIds.description: Task ID or array of task IDs
